anomalies.observed: R1 (10k) is wired from +3V3 to Q2's top pin (emitter side of the BC857), while Q2's base is driven only through R2 from TXD2. There is no base pull-up from +3V3 to Q2's base.
anomalies.expected: R1 should be the base pull-up from +3V3 to Q2's base, with Q2's emitter tied directly to +3V3; R2 should be the series resistor from TXD2 to the base.

evidence.quote: R1 10k is drawn vertically between the +3V3 symbol and Q2's top pin; Q2's base connects to R2 5.1k and TXD2.
R1, R2 | 10k, 5.1k | Bias/divider from /TXD2 into Q2's base.

anomalies.impact: The PNP auto-direction transistor cannot pull the MAX3485 DE/RE enable line high enough, so the RS-485 driver will not enable. Serial servo mode may not transmit at all, while PWM mode is unaffected.

parsed.summary: The schematic largely matches the specification, but R1 is miswired into Q2's emitter path instead of being the base pull-up. This breaks the MAX3485 auto-direction control and likely prevents serial servo operation.
